title: Router aggregate discovery must request aggregated discovery format, or CRD groups on apiextensions targets are never seen
answers: CRD groups served by baas_apiserver not showing up under router /apis
router aggregate target discovery misses apiextensions CRDs
why does discoverGroups only see apiextensions.k8s.io
how does the router decode aggregated discovery (apidiscovery.k8s.io/v2) responses
body:
Symptom: when a standalone apiextensions-apiserver (baas_apiserver) is configured as an aggregate target of the router, none of its CRD-backed groups can be introspected or routed. Only apiextensions.k8s.io shows up.
Root cause: pkg/router/aggregate_discovery.go:discoverGroups sent GET /apis with no Accept header. That server's plain /apis response comes from a static map that is filled once at startup, for apiextensions.k8s.io only. CRD groups are pushed only into the aggregated-discovery manager.
Fix pattern: set `Accept: aggregatedDiscoveryJSON + ", application/json"`. Then decodeDiscoveryResponse picks the decoder from the response Content-Type, not from what was requested: if it contains "apidiscovery.k8s.io", it decodes apidiscoveryv2.APIGroupDiscoveryList; otherwise it decodes the classic metav1.APIGroupList. apiGroupDiscoveryListToGroups converts the aggregated list into []metav1.APIGroup, which is what matchesAnyPattern and newAggregateBackend consume.
Constraints: keep the classic fallback, because older or non-k8s targets may ignore Accept. Versions keep the upstream priority order, and Versions[0] becomes PreferredVersion. Any new discovery format must also be converted into metav1.APIGroup, not passed downstream as-is. Regression test: aggregate_discovery_test.go:TestDiscoverGroups_AggregatedFormat.
